summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Emma Willis, born Emma Griffiths. It describes her 2008 marriage to Busted member Matt Willis at Rushton Hall, Northamptonshire, after three years of dating, and the wedding's coverage in OK magazine. It then lists the couple's three children, Isabelle (2009), Ace (2011) and Trixie (2016).
one_line: Emma Willis, née Griffiths, is the wife of Busted's Matt Willis and mother of three children born between 2009 and 2016.
key_facts: Emma Griffiths married Busted member Matt Willis on 5 July 2008.
The wedding took place at Rushton Hall, Northamptonshire.
The couple had dated for three years before marrying.
The wedding was featured in OK magazine.
Emma Willis gave birth to their first child, a daughter called Isabelle, in June 2009.
The couple's second child, a son called Ace, was born in November 2011.
Emma Willis gave birth to a girl called Trixie in May 2016, her third child.
Matt Willis is a member of the band Busted.
Emma Willis was born Emma Griffiths.
